edges.label: The domain's only two federal dockets, twenty years apart
edges.note: Cash (1984-1986) sought damages and was dismissed on the pleadings and summary judgment; Kean (2003-2009) sought records and obtained a finding of inadequate search plus a supervised re-search. The record case succeeded where the injury case did not.

edges.label: Plaintiff who forced a court-supervised NASA records search
edges.note: Kean filed the complaint on 9 December 2003, obtained a 27 March 2007 finding that NASA had not shown its searches adequate, settled in part on 16 October 2007 and litigated status reports until dismissal on 24 August 2009.
